content.mission: Provide fire-fighting, rescue and emergency medical services and mitigate hazardous materials incidents, protecting life and property.

sequence.label: Rescue
sequence.action: Rescue endangered persons and remove them to areas of safety.

sequence.label: First aid
sequence.action: Provide first aid to casualties and remove them for medical treatment or to areas of safety.

sequence.label: Fire
sequence.action: Take lawful measures to extinguish and prevent the spread of fire and to protect life and property.

sequence.label: Hazardous materials
sequence.action: Take lawful measures to mitigate the consequences of a hazardous materials incident.

sequence.label: Coordinate
sequence.action: Ensure effective coordination between SCDF and the other emergency services.

sequence.label: Inform the public
sequence.action: Disseminate information and advice to the public.

hand_offs.when: After SCDF has saved lives, mitigated the source and done preliminary decontamination and the area is secure, NEA carries out terrain decontamination.
Casualties need management at the incident site and in public hospitals.

workflow.endgame: Fire extinguished, hazardous materials mitigated, casualties removed for treatment.

legal_authorities.power: Functions of SCDF: civil defence duties and day-to-day protection of life, health and safety, including rescue, first aid, firefighting, hazardous-materials mitigation and the emergency ambulance service.

review.notes: Steps restate CDA s. 4 functions in order; the order is Assumed. The fire-ground powers provision (entry, cordon at a fire) was not located in the Fire Safety Act or the Civil Defence Act parts read; recorded as a gap. FSA s. 29 and s. 30 headings (abate fire hazard, close premises in an emergency) seen but not read.
